learner_acceptance.interpretation: Expected UnsupportedOperationException errors prove the visible learner contract reaches the intentional TODO; they are not instructor setup failures or proficiency evidence.

limits: JDBC reducer and schema are instructor-only, using disposable PostgreSQL and synthetic events.
No production callback endpoint, insurer credentials, network calls, support route or real consumer records.
Telemetry table contains only route code, bounded outcome, duration and request ID.
